name: antigravity-claude-proxy

description.en: Proxy that exposes Antigravity provided claude / gemini models, so we can use them in Claude Code and OpenClaw (Clawdbot)
description.zh: 代理将Antigravity提供的Claude/Gemini模型暴露给Claude Code等工具使用。

install: git clone https://github.com/badrisnarayanan/antigravity-claude-proxy（按 README 导入 Gemini CLI）

ecosystems.install: git clone https://github.com/badrisnarayanan/antigravity-claude-proxy（按 README 导入 Gemini CLI）

usecases.zh: 将Antigravity提供的模型用于Claude Code等工具
usecases.en: Use Antigravity models in tools like Claude Code

author: badrisnarayanan
